SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, E.EXAMNAME, Q.QUESTIONCATEGORY, Q.QUESTIONTYPE, Q.QUESTIONCONTENT, Q.ANSWER CORRECTANSWER, L.SINGLECHOICESCORE, L.MULTIPLECHOICESCORE, L.COMPLETIONSCORE, L.JUDGEMENTSCORE, L.SHORTANSWERSCORE, P.ACTIVATEDFLAG FROM T_CORE_EXAM_PAPER_ANSWER A LEFT JOIN T_CORE_EXAM_PAPER P ON A.EXAMPAPERID = P.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_EXAM E ON P.EXAMID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_EXAM_QUESTION EQ ON EQ.ID = A.EXAMQUESTIONID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_QUESTION Q ON A.QUESTIONID = Q.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_EXAM_TMPL L ON L.ID = E.EXAMTMPLID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
